title: Build supercell models
action: Construct the perfect PbWO4 supercell (16 Pb, 16 W, 64 O) and the defect supercell with one lead vacancy from the known scheelite crystal structure.
description: Generate the input structures for the DFT calculations.

title: Lattice relaxation of defect supercell
action: Perform DFT geometry relaxation of the defect supercell using an open-source DFT code with ultrasoft pseudopotentials and a plane-wave kinetic energy cutoff of ~340 eV. Optimize atomic positions until standard convergence criteria are met.
description: Optimize the atomic coordinates of the defect supercell.

title: Electronic structure calculation
action: Run a GGA-DFT electronic structure calculation on the perfect supercell and the relaxed defect supercell. Compute the Kohn-Sham eigenvalues and the total and partial (O 2p) density of states with an SCF convergence tolerance on the order of 1e-6 eV/atom.
description: Obtain the Kohn-Sham eigenvalues and orbitals needed for band-gap determination and optical response.

title: Report band gaps
action: From the electronic structure outputs, determine the band gap of the perfect crystal and the band gap of the defect supercell. Write the results to a JSON file.
description: Contains the computed band gaps (in eV) of perfect PbWO4 and the V_Pb^2--containing supercell.

title: Report in-gap state energy
action: From the electronic structure outputs, locate the O 2p in-gap state above the valence band maximum and write its energy to a JSON file.
description: Contains the energy (eV) of the O 2p-derived in-gap state relative to the VBM.

title: Calculate absorption peaks
action: Compute the frequency-dependent dielectric tensor for the defect supercell using the Kohn-Sham states. Apply a scissors shift of 1.5 eV to conduction bands, BZ integration with 64 k-points, and 0.12 eV smearing. Identify the seven absorption-band maxima in the 1–4.5 eV range and write them as a sorted list to a JSON file.
description: Contains the seven defect-related absorption peak photon energies (eV) sorted in increasing order.
